claims.statement: For homogeneous arity-4 profiles with m>=3, distinguish one tip and define A_{i,t}=G B_3 (L^4+t z)^(m-1)+E and C_t=G B_4 (L^4+t z)^(m-1), with E=z L^(4m). At k=m+4, the coefficient of t^(2m-3) in A_{i,t}[k]C_t[k]-A_{i,t}[k+1]C_t[k-1] equals -33(m-1).
claims.scope: Exact obstruction to coefficientwise nonnegativity in this activity basis for the guarded shifted tip comparison, at 1<=k and 2k<=N+2 with N=4m. This coefficient does not refute the t=1 shifted comparison, the actual first-descent strict-selector mechanism, or any payment claim. Original tip multiplicity is one for the distinguished tip; the conclusion is only about its individual shifted minor.
claims.reason: Exact layer extraction leaves only activity-degree splits (m-2,m-1) and (m-1,m-2); their local coefficient combination is -33 times the binomial factor m-1. The guard holds for every m>=3. The m=3 exact full t=1 margin is positive, and its k is not actual-eligible, so the obstruction is mechanism-specific.

limitations: No adaptive activity window, omitted-tail bound, or positive paired-layer certificate was found.
The negative coefficient invalidates only coefficientwise positivity in this activity basis; cancellation at t=1 may still prove the registered comparison.
The m=3 example has actual first descent x=7 and no eligible lower-half p; it is not a full-payment or primary counterexample.
No universal resolution of the registered individual or weighted shifted comparisons, or the ULC exact-ratio surplus condition, is claimed.
